Reflect_prior_six_refs.claim: Management disclosed a shift away from paid member acquisition and performance marketing toward brand and organic investment, while warning of short-term pressure on revenue and paying users.
Reflect_prior_six_refs.exact_text: To align with these priorities, we have strategically shifted away from paid member acquisition and performance marketing in favor of brand and organic investment. As we address these areas of focus, our member growth and success in attracting new members, member engagement and monetization may be negatively impacted. In addition, efforts to improve the health of our membership base, including the removal of bad actors from our apps and strategically reducing paid performance marketing for member acquisition, may adversely affect revenue and paying users in the short term.

Reflect_prior_six_refs.claim: As of June 30, 2025, cash and cash equivalents were $261.7 million; management believed available resources sufficient for its business plans during the next twelve months, based on conditions then.
Reflect_prior_six_refs.exact_text: As of June 30, 2025, we had $261.7 million of cash and cash equivalents, an increase of $57.4 million from December 31, 2024. Our principal sources of liquidity are our cash and cash equivalents and cash generated from operations. Our primary uses of liquidity are operating expenses and capital expenditures, acquisition of businesses, funding of our debt obligations, partnership tax distributions, paying income taxes and obligations under our tax receivable agreement and effectuating share repurchases as discussed below. Based on current conditions, we believe that we have sufficient financial resources to fund our activities and execute our business plans during the next twelve months.

Reflect_prior_six_refs.claim: In June 2025, management announced a global workforce reduction of approximately 240 roles, representing approximately 30% of employees.
Reflect_prior_six_refs.exact_text: In June 2025, we announced our decision to reduce our global workforce by approximately 240 roles, representing approximately 30% of our employees, as we realign our operating structure to optimize execution on our strategic priorities.

interpretation.summary: Neutral capital-structure facts: the issuer completed first-half 2025 share repurchases of 4.7 million shares for $28.7 million, excluding excise tax obligations, and repaid $2.9 million under its Original Term Loan. All treasury shares were retired by June 30, with no second-quarter repurchases. These historical actions document repayment and share retirement, but the cited spans do not establish a prospective net-dilution change or a within-horizon change in runway, distress, or tradability relevant to the fixed surge target. Revolving credit availability and covenant compliance describe the existing position rather than an independently established directional catalyst. Additional evidence may exist in omitted text.
